# Fiscal evidence

The independent oracle is generated by unchanged Python 3.12 fiscal, measures,
annual-period and cleaned debt-text code at `bd973a0a3dfbc8d8bd03ac85e6aa1f0784669bf2`.
All input paths are redirected to `inputs/`; no live registry, cache or release
is read. `datasets-provenance.json` inventories hashes for every input and
oracle. The inputs include the forecast and bill extraction JSON and the exact
tracked 2027 ZIP: Python verifies both archive and PDF member hashes before
constructing the annual records. `datasets.yaml` is a separate frozen registry
for the scoped comparator. The published files are baseline snapshots, used as
an additional expectation; they are not builder inputs.

The cleaned ASBP page and table evidence came from
`release-build-inputs-2026-11-08-period-selector-complete.tar.gz`, whose SHA-256
is recorded in provenance. The original historical DOCX used to author the
measure transcription and excerpts is not available here; those authored
inputs and their source excerpts are identified as such, rather than claimed
as a fresh extraction. Adopted-law paragraphs are the Python-extracted blocks
from the frozen law fixture. No raw PDF, DOCX or law HTML reader is ported.

Regenerate and verify from these copies with Python 3.12:

```sh
PYTHONPATH=pipeline python3.12 packages/ingest/test/fixtures/fiscal/generate_oracle.py --check
PYTHONPATH=pipeline python3.12 packages/ingest/test/fixtures/fiscal/generate_datasets.py --check
```

`donor/` captures the four builders before layering; `oracle/` captures those
outputs after the additive annual period layer. The wording, active-data and
source layers do not modify these four files. `published/` is the frozen
baseline for independent final comparison. `debt-text-oracle.json` captures
all cleaned text readers and the adopted-law limits. CI checks all three stages
with exact comparisons, no tolerances or accepted differences, and writes its
report under `tmp/ts-migration/candidates/candidate03/`.

The test-only builder rejects output paths outside candidate03, symlinks and
hard-linked output files. To compare the frozen-input candidate with the current
release separately, run `pnpm fiscal:compare-live`; this is not a CI parity gate.
